title: serialize_typed_slice / deserialize_typed_slice for Contiguous Numeric Arrays (10X or more performance)
author: stephenberry
body_preview: Add optional methods to `serde::Serializer` and `serde::Deserializer` for bulk serialization/deserialization of contiguous numeric slices. This enables binary formats to memcpy typed arrays in a single operation instead of processing elements one at a time.
